name: IC 3065 (Hubble)
blurb: IC 3065, a lenticular galaxy in the Virgo Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: ic3065-hubble
story: A smooth early-type galaxy in the Virgo Cluster, the largest gathering of elliptical and lenticular galaxies near us. Hubble imaged it as one of 100 early-type galaxies in a survey of the cluster, studying their globular clusters and measuring their distances.

claims.text: VCC 140 is IC 3065, classified S0 (lenticular), in the ACS Virgo Cluster Survey sample
The Virgo Cluster is the largest collection of elliptical and lenticular galaxies in the nearby universe
The ACS Virgo Cluster Survey imaged 100 early-type galaxies in the Virgo Cluster
Survey goals include its galaxies' globular clusters and distances
